clues.text: After the flood, Noah's dove came back in the evening with a freshly plucked leaf from this tree.
When the trees sought a king in Jotham's story, this tree refused, unwilling to stop giving its oil.
In a vision, Zechariah saw two of these trees beside a solid gold lampstand, one on each side.
Paul told Gentile believers they were a wild shoot grafted into this tree to share its nourishing root.
In the temple's inner sanctuary, Solomon made two cherubim, each ten cubits high, from this tree's wood.
Samson's foxes, with torches tied to their tails, burned the Philistines' grain, vineyards, and groves of this tree.
A song of ascents says the sons of a man who fears the LORD are like this tree's shoots around his table.
